name: com.abstractpixel.library
description: Core engineering utilities and Save System modules.

samples.description: The daily way: [Save] on a MonoBehaviour's field, and on a plain C# class with one SaveActions.Register(this) line.

samples.displayName: Save System 02 Buttons With No Code
samples.description: Save Transform, Save Active State and Save Destroyed on level objects, and uGUI buttons wired to Mono Save Actions.

samples.displayName: Save System 03 Save Slots And Continue
samples.description: A save slot screen: create, open and delete game profiles by slot number, plus a Continue button.

samples.displayName: Save System 04 Pick A Save File
samples.description: ISaveIn<TFile> puts data in a Global, GameProfile or Scene file; Save<TFile>() and a typed load listener.
Goblins spawned from one prefab, each with its own save ID from SetSaveId; defeated ones stay defeated.

samples.displayName: Save System 06 Custom Data With ISavable
samples.description: A plain C# Inventory that moves its own data with ISavable<T>, for data that isn't plain fields.

samples.displayName: Save System 07 Whole Files With SaveStorage
samples.description: A debug screen that reads, copies, pastes and deletes a whole save file as JSON text.
A GameProgress asset with [Save] fields that registers itself with the save system.
